entries.en: £trigger_yes£ Has been elected §HCustodian§! of the §YGalactic Community§!

entries.zh: £trigger_no£已被选为§Y星海共同体§!的§H监管人§!
entries.en: £trigger_no£  Has been elected §HCustodian§! of the §YGalactic Community§!

entries.zh: 完成§H野望目标§!以获取£integrity£§Y英武值§!。
英武值反映了我们保卫星系不遭受毁灭和暴政的决心。
entries.en: Valor measures our dedication to safeguard the galaxy against destruction and tyranny.

entries.zh: 我们从这项野望目标中获得了£integrity£$AMOUNT$。
entries.en: We have gained £integrity£ $AMOUNT$ from this Ambition Objective.

entries.zh: 要提升野望等级，需要累积英武值。
entries.en: To advance through the Ambition levels, accumulate Valor.

entries.zh:
星海共同体中那些希图在历史的长河中照见未来的人们长期以来一直设想会有一场将要降临的§R天灾§!——一场所有智慧生命的生死危机，唯有倚仗前所未有的万众一心与前仆后继方能克服——如果真有可能克服的话。

关于何为这场天灾的本质的流言蜚语，许多都属于异想天开，比如系外掠食者入侵，再比如星系中机械智能星火燎原，又或是其他位面的继位战争波及而至，然而……

如今显而易见的是，§G我们§!将会肩负起捍卫星系的重任。

无论出现何种恐怖或暴虐，他们都会发现有人在守卫着我们的共同家园。很快，所有人都会知道宇宙的这一隅是何等地坚不可摧。
entries.en:
Those in the galactic community who chart the arc of history have long predicted a coming §RCrisis§! - an existential threat to all sapient life which would require unprecedented unity of purpose, and sacrifice, to overcome. If it can be overcome at all.

Popular predictions as to the nature of this crisis have been as fanciful as the invasion of an extragalactic glutton, or the galaxy's machine intelligences rising up in petty rebellion, or a war of succession spilling over from another plane of existence, and...

It is now clear that the protection of the galaxy will fall to §Gus§!.

No matter the horrors and tyrants that rise up, they will find our home to be well protected. Soon, all will learn that this side of universe shall never be broken!

entries.zh: 完成§H野望目标§!来产生£integrity£§H英武值§!，可以证明我们的决心，让星系所有自由帝国团结在我们身后，共同捍卫生命和自由。
entries.en: Pursuing §HAmbition Objectives§! generates £integrity£ §HValor§!, an evidence of our dedication that will rally the free nations of the galaxy behind us in defense of life and liberty.

entries.zh: 团结就是力量。我们的事业固然正义，但如果不能团结一致正义也将凋亡。如果星系不愿意被守护，我们也将无从守护，因此而我们必须获得志同道合者们肩并肩、心连心的支持。\n\n签订§Y防御条约§!或授予§Y联邦合作国地位§!可以按§Y年度§!获得这项英武值奖励。
entries.en: Power lies in unity. Our cause is just, but justice without allies cannot endure. We cannot protect a galaxy that does not want to be protected, so we must seek those who share our values and will fight beside us, heart to heart and mind to mind.\n\nForm §YDefensive Pacts§! or grant §YFederation Association Status§! to gain this §Yannual§! Valor reward.

entries.zh: 联邦的纽带是难以断绝的。和友好的帝国协作一致将能携手共创新的繁荣时代。\n\n加入或创建§Y联邦§!可以按§Y年度§!获得这项英武值奖励。
entries.en: The bonds of a federation are not easily undone. Cooperation and harmony with like-minded empires will lift us all into a new age of prosperity.\n\nJoin or Create a §YFederation§! to gain this §Yannual§! Valor reward.
Do not take part in Wars of Aggression

entries.zh: 守护者从不凌虐他人；只有坚定立场才能获得星系的信任。\n\n不§Y进攻§!或加入任何一场战争的§Y进攻§!方可以按§Y月度§!获得这项英武值奖励。
entries.en: We are guardians, not aggressors; only in standing firm do we earn the galaxy's trust.\n\nDo not §YAttack§! or join the §YAttacking§! side in any war to gain this §Ymonthly§! Valor reward.

entries.zh: 星海共同体的民主框架是凝聚共识的最佳手段。我们可以由此共同铸成一面坚盾，既能抵御一切威胁，又能照顾所有成员的自主权。\n\n成功支持星海共同体的§Y议案§!可以获得该英武值奖励。
entries.en: The Galactic Community's democratic framework is our best means of forging unity. Through it, we may become a single shield, one strong enough to withstand any threat, yet tempered by respect for the autonomy of its members.\n\nSupport successful §YResolutions§! in the Galactic Community to gain this Valor reward.

entries.zh: 武力是我们的底牌，但对星系的敌人我们绝不手软。\n\n摧毁属于§Y天灾§!的舰船可以获得该英武值奖励。
entries.en: Strength should be our last resort, but there can be no quarter given to the enemies of the galaxy.\n\nDestroy ships owned by a §YCrisis§! to gain this Valor reward.

entries.zh: 我们不惹事，但绝不姑息星系中的危险分子。到万不得已时，我们会让掠夺者只作为课本上的反面案例存在。\n\n摧毁§Y天灾帝国§!可以获得该英武值奖励。
entries.en: We do not seek war, but we will not suffer those who imperil the galaxy. If forced, we will ensure these despoilers are remembered only as a lesson.\n\nDestroy §YCrisis Empires§! to gain this Valor reward.

entries.zh: 英武值可以通过直接捍卫星系的行为获取。我们将以自身的行动证明自己是为了守护大家而非一己私利在行动着。
entries.en: Valor is earned through steadfast action in defense of the galaxy. It is not given, but earned, proof that we act not in self-interest, but for the protection of all.
Allows the accumulation of £integrity£ §Y$menp_defender_objectives$§! by completing §HAmbition Objectives§!

entries.zh: 要引领众人我们必须先为人所知，不是通过淫威，而是给人以希望。我们主动深处双手，去帮助他人、传递信息，在星际间建立信任。
entries.en: To lead, we must be known, not through fear, but through hope. We will invest in outreach that uplifts, informs, and builds trust across the stars.

entries.zh: 提升所有能正常外交国家的£opinion£§Y评价§!§G+40§!
entries.en: Increases the £opinion£ §YOpinion§! of empires capable of regular diplomacy by §G+40§!

entries.zh: 演讲的优劣取决于其演讲者。我们必须根据听众的需求调整措辞，触及他们的心灵和思想——无论他们与我们看起来多么格格不入。
entries.en: A speech is only as good as its orator. We must tailor our words to reach the hearts and minds of our peers - however alien they may appear to us.

entries.zh: 联邦管理机构是一种强大的工具，可加以运用以惠及我们所有盟友。
entries.en: Federal administration is a powerful tool that can be leveraged for the benefit of all our allies.

entries.zh: 我们的意志坚不可摧，绝不会因惧怕受伤而在战斗中退缩。
entries.en: Our spirit is strong, and we won't back down from a fight for fear of getting hurt.

entries.zh: 我们的影响力日益增强，随之提升的是我们在星海共同体中推动变革的能力。盟友信任我们，我们必须努力才能不辜负他们的信任。
entries.en: Our influence grows, and with it, our ability to enact change in the Galactic Community. Our allies trust us, and we must strive to honor their faith.

entries.zh: 解锁在§Y盟友§!的恒星系建造部分§Y设施§!的能力。\n
entries.en: Unlocks the ability to build some §YStructures§! in §YAllied§! Systems.\n

entries.zh: 我们保护星系，但很高兴知道也有其他人保护我们。通过互相依赖，我们都变得更强大。
entries.en: We protect the galaxy, but it is good to know that others protect us too. By relying upon each other, we all become stronger.

entries.zh: 星系信任我们，我们绝不会让他们失望。
entries.en: The Galaxy believes in us, and we are not about to let them down.

entries.zh: 象征主义长期以来塑造着各个帝国的进程。为了消除一切对我们事业的疑虑，我们必须塑造出明确无误的象征，让整个星系都能在其下团结起来。
entries.en: Symbolism has long shaped the course of empires. To dispel any lingering doubt as to our purpose, we must forge unmistakable emblems behind which the entire galaxy can rally.

entries.zh: 提升所有能正常外交国家的£opinion£§Y评价§!§G+100§!\n在星海共同体解锁§Y圣武士倡议§!议案。
entries.en: Increases the £opinion£ §YOpinion§! of empires capable of regular diplomacy to a total of §G+100§!\nUnlocks the §YPaladin Initiative§! resolution in the Galactic Community.

entries.zh: 知识就是力量，但真正的强大蕴含在知识的交流中。通过与盟友分享知识，我们证明了掌握力量不需要彼此分裂。明智地运用知识，它将使我们为了共同的目标团结起来。
entries.en: Knowledge may be power, but true strength lies in its exchange. By sharing knowledge with our allies, we show that power need not divide. Used wisely, it unites us in common purpose.

entries.zh: 舰队是我们的主要武器，但不是唯一的。敌人可以在我们防御空间站的砧板上被阻滞，这样我们的舰队之锤就可以狠狠地打击他们。
entries.en: Our fleets are our main weapon, but not the only one. Enemies can be halted upon the anvil of our stations so the hammer of our armada can strike them.

entries.zh: 求死并无美德可言，但愿为正义事业冒生命的风险，则是一种荣耀。在保卫星系的战斗中取得胜利需要牺牲，那些为他人献出生命的人绝不能被遗忘。
entries.en: There is no virtue in seeking death, but in accepting its possibility for a just cause, there is honor. Victory in the defense of the galaxy demands sacrifice, and those who give their lives for others must never be forgotten.

entries.zh: 我们已经向全星系证明了自己。无数星球的公民们内心深知，我们将会为了保护它们而战斗到最后。
entries.en: We have proven ourselves in the eyes of the galaxy. Citizens across countless worlds know in their heart that we will fight until the bitter end to protect them.

entries.zh: 提升所有能正常外交国家的£opinion£§Y评价§!§G+200§!\n在星海共同体解锁§Y圣武士§!议案。
entries.en: Increases the £opinion£ §YOpinion§! of empires capable of regular diplomacy to a total of §G+200§!\nUnlocks new §YPaladin§! resolutions in the Galactic Community.

entries.zh: 能力越大，责任越大。守护者的职责是为了共同的利益而承担的重担。这些力量绝不能用于野心，而应为了激发星系的最高理想而施展。
entries.en: With extraordinary power comes extraordinary responsibility. The mantle of Custodianship is a burden borne for the common good. These powers must never be wielded for ambition, but to draw forth the galaxy's highest ideals.

entries.zh: 在§Y[GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]§!解锁4项特殊的监管人§Y议案§!。
面对注定的毁灭，我们并不因为强过他人而挺身而出，而是因为我们必须这样做。
entries.en: In the face of certain annihilation, we do not stand because we are stronger. We stand because we must.

entries.zh: 我们打破了一些战争规则，并且深知其代价。当目前的危机结束后，我们将会受到审判。而我们必去竭尽所能确保这个星系能幸存到审判我们的时候。
entries.en: There are rules of war we have broken, and with full knowledge of the cost. When the current crisis is over, we will be judged. Until then, we do what we must to ensure a galaxy remains to judge us.

entries.zh: 防御总是笼罩在神秘之中，但在我们目前的境况下，星系系必须团结起来，制定出抵御其宿敌的最佳方法。
entries.en: Defense is always veiled in secrecy, but in the situation that is ours, the galaxy must band together to devise the best way to fend off its mortal enemies.

entries.zh: 在§Y[GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]§!解锁特殊的天灾分析§Y议案§!。
entries.en: Unlocks special Crisis Analysis §YResolutions§! in the §Y[GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]§!.

entries.zh: 我们的战士深知他们的职责，他们将为拯救我们所有人做出崇高牺牲，他们的名字将永远铭刻在星系史册中。
entries.en: Our soldiers know their duty, and that their names will be forever etched in galactic history after they pay the ultimate price to save us all.

entries.zh: 人为了自己的使命献出生命。但在那一天到来之前，我们决不能肆意浪费自己人的性命。
entries.en: There is a time and place to give your life in service of a cause. Until the time comes, we cannot afford to squander the lives of our people.

entries.zh: 那种促使我们隐瞒技术进步的自私保密行为再也不能容忍了。我们的盟友越强大，我们就越强大。
entries.en: The selfish secrecy that pushes us to occult our technological progress cannot be tolerated anymore. The stronger our allies, the stronger we are.

entries.zh: 我们将捍卫每一颗恒星。我们将捍卫每一颗行星。我们将捍卫一切生命。我们捍卫我们家园的每一寸土地！
entries.en: We will fight for every star. We will fight for every world. We will fight for every life. We will fight for every inch of our home!

entries.zh: 泛星系防卫军是我们对付可能威胁星系的恐怖威胁时的最强之矛。它的组织架构超越[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]内的琐碎争吵，是星系中最可靠的军事力量。
entries.en: The Galactic Defense Force is our best shot at surviving the horrors that might threaten our galaxy. Above the petty squabbles of the [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium], it is the most reliable military force in the galaxy.

entries.zh: [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]成员之间的协调演习将有助于对潜在的暴君和入侵者形成统一战线。我们将同心协力，战无不胜。
entries.en: Coordinated exercises between members of the [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium] will help present a united front against would-be tyrants and invaders. Together, we shall be indomitable.

entries.zh: 领导的重担很沉重，但通过与星系其他成员合作，我们可以调配无与伦比的资源来帮助[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]的成员，让他们能有机会反过来帮助所有人。
entries.en: The burden of leadership is heavy, but by collaborating with other members of the [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium], we can allocate extraordinary resources to help the members of the Galactic Council so that they may help everyone in turn.

entries.zh: £trigger_no£星河卫士不能登基成星海帝皇
entries.en: £trigger_no£Defenders of the Galaxy can not become Galactic Emperor

entries.zh: 星系需要鼓舞人心、具有亲切感的形象来为我们的舰队增添亲和力，带领我们的军队走向胜利。
entries.en: The galaxy needs inspiration, relatable figures to give a friendly face to our fleets and lead our forces to victory.

entries.zh: 解锁§Y$PALADIN_SHIP_PROJECT$§!特殊项目让我们能将具有号召力的英雄部署在特殊舰船上。
entries.en: Unlocks the §Y$PALADIN_SHIP_PROJECT$§! Special Project that will let us field inspiring heroes in special ships.

entries.zh: £trigger_no£需要通过§H泛星系防卫军§!议案
entries.en: £trigger_no£ Requires passing the §HGalactic Defense Force§! resolution

entries.zh: 英雄的时代已经过去。我们感谢圣武士们所做的一切，并知道如果需要，他们将随时准备为我们的安全而战。
entries.en: The time of heroes has passed. We thank the Paladins for their services, and know that they will stand ready to fight for our safety should the need arise again.

entries.zh: 通过与理事会成员分享监管人的一部分权力，我们可以委托他们处理行政事务，并相信他们会简化参议院的流程。
entries.en: By sharing some of the Custodian's powers with the members of the council, we can delegate administrative tasks, and trust them to streamline the senatorial processes.

entries.zh: 欲速则不达，冗长的参议院会议在民主上是有价值的，它能提供更多的辩论空间。
entries.en: Sometimes faster is not always better, and there is democratic value to be found in longer senate sessions, that give more room for debate.

entries.zh: 大可汗是一位可怕的军事领袖，但他的军队仍然是一群乌合之众，他们仅仅通过纯粹的残暴来弥补纪律的不足。
entries.en: The Khan is a fearsome military leader, but his troops are still a rag tag bunch, only making up for their lack of discipline through sheer brutality.

entries.zh: 灰蛊风暴产生的纳米云团虽然可怕，但它们遵循着特定的程序。如果我们能破解它们的行为算法，我们就能彻底击败它们。
entries.en: The nanite clouds of the Gray Tempest are terrifying, but obey a specific programming. If we can crack their algorithms, we can crack them.

entries.zh: 那些丑陋的虚空蠕虫不过是野兽。想出有效的反制策略应该不难。
entries.en: The repulsive voidworms, are nothing but beasts. It shouldn't take much work to come up with an effective counter strategy.

entries.zh: 塞塔娜是一个狡猾的敌人，但在她神秘的笑容背后，是冰冷的程序。合成女王也许不会流血，但我们一样可以打败她。
entries.en: Cetana is a cunning foe, but behind her enigmatic smile lie ice cold code. The Synthetic Queen may not bleed, but we can defeat her.

entries.zh: 从某种意义上说，索林原虫永不满足的饥饿感使它们变得可预测。它们凶猛，但并非不可战胜。
entries.en: In a sense, the inextinguishable hunger driving the Prethoryns make them predictable. They are fierce, but not indomitable.

entries.zh: 肃正协议的无情逻辑令人毛骨悚然，但其舰船早在亿万年前就已设计完成。我们一定能找到击败他们的方法。
entries.en: The soulless logic of the Contingency is uncanny, but its ships were designed eons ago. Surely, we can come up with the means to defeat them.

entries.zh: 邪恶的破界者及其同类对能量武器和护盾的依赖可能会成为他们的末日。
entries.en: The vile Unbidden and their kin's reliance on energy weapons and shields might prove to be their undoing.

entries.zh: 我们不再需要维持战略委员会这一机构了。
entries.en: We do not need to maintain our strategic committees anymore.

entries.zh: 所有生效的§H$crisis_analysis$§!议案均被取消
新的危机需要我们的关注
entries.en: A new crisis needs our attention

entries.zh: 圣骑士需要练习并肩作战，以克服最严峻的威胁。
entries.en: Paladins need to practice working together to overcome the gravest threat.

entries.zh: 圣武士不仅仅是指挥官。他们是以谋略和坚定勇气领导的楷模，召集盟友，并在最需要的地方坚定不移。
entries.en: Paladins are more than commanders. They are exemplars who lead with strategy and unshakable valor, rallying allies and standing firm where the need is greatest.

entries.zh: 委托给我们圣武士的武器未经测试，危险重重，且破坏力太大，不宜广泛使用。我们现在部署它们是因为情势所迫别无选择，相信我们的圣武士会光荣地使用它们。
entries.en: The weapons entrusted to our Paladins are untested, perilous, and far too destructive for widespread use. We deploy them now because the stakes leave us no alternative, trusting our Paladins to wield them with honor.

entries.zh: §R仅能通过一项圣武士§Y焦点§!议案。§!
entries.en: §ROnly one Paladin §YFocus§! Resolution can be Passed.§!

entries.zh: 虽然每位圣武士独自作战时都十分强大，但他们真正的力量在于团结。并肩作战时，他们的勇气不只能鼓舞士气，更是势不可挡的力量。
entries.en: Though each Paladin is powerful alone, their true strength lies in unity. When they fight together, their valor does more than inspire. It becomes unstoppable.

entries.zh:
$only_one_paladin_training$

位于同一恒星系的§Y圣武士§!相互赋予以下修正：
—$MOD_SHIP_DAMAGE_REDUCTION_MULT$：§G2.5%§!
—$MOD_SHIP_FIRE_RATE_MULT$：§G2.5%§!
entries.en:
$only_one_paladin_training$

§YPaladins§! in a system grant each other the following modifier:
- $MOD_SHIP_DAMAGE_REDUCTION_MULT$: §G2.5%§!
- $MOD_SHIP_FIRE_RATE_MULT$: §G2.5%§!

entries.zh: 也许圣武士的陨落也能激发斗志，但只有活着才能保护人民。让他们存续下去不是感情用事，而是战略需要。我们将投入一切必要的资源，让他们活跃在前线。
entries.en: A fallen Paladin may inspire, but a living one protects. Their survival is not sentiment, but strategy. We will commit all necessary resources to keeping them on the front lines.

entries.zh:
$only_one_paladin_training$

§Y圣武士§!领袖特质赋予以下效果：
$MOD_SHIP_EVASION_MULT$：§G25%§!
$MOD_SHIP_SHIELD_REGEN_ADD_PERC$：§G20%§!
和平有时需要超越克制的强大力量。圣武士的出击并非出于愤怒，而是为了维护必须存续的事物。
entries.en: Peace sometimes requires strength beyond restraint. Paladins strike not in anger, but to preserve what must endure.

entries.zh:
$only_one_paladin_training$

§Y圣武士§!领袖特质赋予以下效果：
$MOD_SHIP_WEAPON_DAMAGE$：§G30%§!
$MOD_SHIP_WEAPON_RANGE_MULT$：§G25%§!
§R仅能通过一项圣武士§Y训练§!议案。§!
entries.en: §ROnly one Paladin §YTraining§! Resolution can be Passed.§!

entries.zh: 威胁我们的灾厄迫使我们出台紧急措施。我们必须召集圣武士团集结到监管人的麾下。
entries.en: The peril threatening us calls for extraordinary measures. We must rally the Paladins under the command of the Custodian.

entries.zh: 危机时刻已过，对特殊指挥的需求也随之消失。圣武士们现在将回归标准的指挥链，他们的职责已完成。
entries.en: The time of crisis has passed, and with it, the need for extraordinary command. The Paladins shall now return to the standard chain of authority, their charge fulfilled.

entries.zh: 全体§Y圣武士§!现在由监管人直接指挥控制
entries.en: All §YPaladins§! will be directly controlled by the Custodian

entries.zh: 现在讨论这个还为时过早。
entries.en: It is too early to discuss this.

entries.zh: 星系是一个美丽的地方，值得我们去保护。这里有无数的民族、希望和梦想，每一个都值得被守护。我们不寻求权力，只求和平。但和平必须得到捍卫。对于那些想要征服、毁灭或腐蚀和平的人，我们将挺身而出。只要我们屹立不倒，星系也将永存。
entries.en: The galaxy is a beautiful place, worth preserving. A place of countless peoples, hopes, and dreams, each one deserving of protection. We do not seek power, only peace. But peace must be defended. Against those who would conquer, destroy, or corrupt, we will stand. And as long as we stand, so too shall the galaxy.

entries.zh:
我们若忽视这些迹象，那将是愚蠢的。这个星系中存在着邪恶势力，它们会毁掉我们努力保护的一切。我们不能坐等风暴爆发。我们必须准备好行动。

让那些威胁这个星系的人知道：我们一定会找到他们。

§H目标§!：
—消灭所有危机帝国
—击败两次终末危机
—辞去监管人职位
entries.en:
We would be foolish to ignore the signs. There are forces of evil in this galaxy that would unmake all we strive to protect. We cannot wait for the storm to break. We must be prepared to act.

Let those who threaten this galaxy know: we will find them.

§HOBJECTIVES§!:
- Eliminate all Crisis Empires
- Defeat two End Game Crisis
- Then End your Custodianship

entries.zh:
没有人能独自守护星系。

在采取行动之前，我们必须赢得我们希望保护之人的信任。这种信任始于诚实、克制和外交。

我们将培养新一代特使，通过言行证明我们在此是为了提供帮助。只有齐心协力，我们才能建立足以抵御未来挑战的强大联盟。
entries.en:
No one defends the galaxy alone.

Before we can act, we must earn the trust of those we hope to protect. That trust begins with honesty, restraint, and diplomacy.

We will train a new generation of envoys to prove through word and deed that we are here to help. Only together can we build alliances strong enough to weather what lies ahead.

entries.zh:
我们已经取得了信任。但我们必须培养信念。

既然星系与我们同在，我们必须给它的人民一些可以信仰的东西，一些即使在最黑暗的时刻也能经久不衰的象征。不仅仅是旗帜或口号，而是勇气、团结和坚不可摧的承诺的标志，我们将站在他们与风暴之间。

让每一个感性众生都看向这些象征，并记住：他们并不孤单。
entries.en:
Trust is earned. Faith must be nurtured.

Now that the galaxy stands with us, we must give its people something to believe in, symbols that can endure even the darkest hour. Not mere banners or slogans, but emblems of courage, unity, and the unshakable promise that we will stand between them and the storm.

Let every sentient being look to these symbols and remember: they are not alone.

entries.zh: 星系中存在的威胁不容忽视。我们不能坐等黑暗降临。我们将谨慎而小心地展开一系列高风险行动，以揭示前方潜藏的危险。\n\n§R这将触发终末危机§!
entries.en: The galaxy holds threats too great to ignore. We cannot afford to wait for the darkness to reveal itself. With caution and care, we will begin a series of high-risk operations to uncover what dangers lie ahead.\n\n§RThis will trigger the End Game Crisis§!

entries.zh:
我们前期所作的大量工作已被证明是必要的，尽管我们也取得了成功，但这并不是终点。

星系浩瀚无垠，危机四伏。我们必须继续搜寻，确保没有威胁能逃过我们的监视。

这些实验是危险的，但如果邪恶仍然潜伏在黑暗中，我们别无选择，只能面对它。

§R这将触发第二次终末危机§!
entries.en:
Our early efforts have proven necessary, and though successful, they are not the end.

The galaxy is vast and full of danger. We must continue our search to ensure that no threat escapes our watch.

These experiments are perilous, but if evil still lurks in the dark, we have no choice but to face it.

§RThis will trigger a second End Game Crisis§!

entries.zh: 艺术与科技相结合，创造出在黑暗中熠熠生辉的自由象征。
entries.en: Art meets technology to create symbols of freedom that will shine bright against the darkness.

entries.zh: 成为星海共同体的成员国
entries.en: Be part of the Galactic Community

entries.zh: 若想驾驭星系的民主机器，我们首先需确保有一席之地。
entries.en: If we wish to steer the democratic apparatus of the galaxy, we first need to secure our seat at the table.

entries.zh: 在星系理事会拥有一席
设立星系理事会是建立星系安全流程的必要步骤。\n\n若要被选为§H理事会成员§!，我们必须：$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—在§H星海共同体§!中通过$resolution_galacticreforms_form_council$决议$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—确保我国按§H外交权重§!在整个共同体中排名前三
entries.en: The creation of a galactic council is a necessary step to establish processes for galactic security.\n\nTo be elected §HCouncilor§!, we must:$TABBED_NEW_LINE$-Pass the $resolution_galacticreforms_form_council$ Resolution in the §HGalactic Community§!$TABBED_NEW_LINE$-Ensure that we are among the top three empires in the community, ranked by §HDiplomatic Weight§!

entries.zh: 监管人的身份是一个负担。但为了星系，我们责无旁贷。\n\n要成为§H监管人§!，我们必须：$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—在§H星海共同体§!中通过§H$resolution_galacticreforms_nominate_custodian$：[Root.GetName]§!决议
entries.en: The Custodianship is a burden. One we shall bear in service of the Galaxy.\n\nTo become §HCustodian§!, we must:$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Pass the §H$resolution_galacticreforms_nominate_custodian$: [Root.GetName]§! Resolution in the §HGalactic Community§!

entries.zh: 我们的星系比看起来更脆弱。危险从四面八方逼近：捕食者潜伏于虚空，海盗盘踞在无主恒星系，傲慢和恐惧也在引发着战争。而那些有能力行动的人却常常保持沉默。\n\n而我们不会袖手旁观。这并非宣称统治，而是承诺守护。通过审慎的行动和共同的目标，我们将确保星系拥有值得守护的未来。
entries.en: Our galaxy is more fragile than it appears. Dangers press in from every direction: predators lurking in the void, pirates in forgotten systems, wars born of pride and fear. And too often, those with the power to act remain silent.\n\nWe will not stand idle. This is not a claim of dominance, but a commitment to stewardship. Through measured action and shared purpose, we will ensure the galaxy has a future worth protecting.

entries.zh: 我们会做我们必须做的事。
entries.en: We will do what we must.

entries.zh: 统一星系并非仅凭武力或个人意志就能实现。它需要信任、对话，以及承担他人不敢承担的重担的意愿。每一次联盟的建立，每一次危机的化解，都是迈向更具韧性未来的小小一步。\n\n我们寻求的不是统治，而是引领：在他人踉跄时，伸出援手。我们的工作永无止境，也常常不被感谢，但这职责正是我们的使命。我们将共同塑造一个永恒的星系。
entries.en: Uniting the galaxy will not be achieved through force of arms or singular will alone. It will take trust, dialogue, and the willingness to shoulder burdens no one else dares to bear. Every alliance formed, every crisis defused, is a small step toward a more resilient future.\n\nWe seek not to rule, but to lead: to offer a steady hand when others falter. Our work is tireless, and often thankless, but this duty is our purpose. Together, we will shape an enduring galaxy.

entries.zh: 我们的存在即是为整个星系服务。
entries.en: We live to serve the galaxy.

entries.zh: 在这个充满不确定性的年代，象征的意义重大。星系不仅需要保护，还需要启示。随着威胁的日益大胆和前路的黯淡，我们的计划也逐渐成型：一支由来自已知宇宙各个角落的英杰组成的先锋队，他们将化身我们为之奋斗的理想。\n\n这些圣武士不仅会指挥舰队或协调救援工作。他们必须成为我们共同决心的活生生的证明。他们是英雄，不是某个民族的英雄，而是所有人的英雄。
entries.en: In times of uncertainty, symbols matter. The galaxy does not only need protection, it needs inspiration. As threats grow bolder and the path ahead darkens, our plan is taking shape: a vanguard of exceptional individuals, drawn from every corner of known space, who will embody the ideals we fight to uphold.\n\nThese Paladins would not merely command fleets or coordinate relief efforts. They must be the living testament of our shared resolve. Heroes, not of a single people, but of all.

entries.zh: 它们将成为星系的指路明灯。
entries.en: They shall be the galaxy's guiding light.

entries.zh: 星系已经发声，不是出于恐惧，而是出于信任。我们被选为守护者，并被授予了超越普通授权范围的权力。这些非凡的特权，虽然是因必需而生，但并非我们所寻求的荣誉。它们是我们为了一切而接受的重担。\n\n我们不会只为颐指气使行使此等权力，而只为服务。我们将信守誓言，直到威胁不再于繁星之外虎视眈眈，直到和平不再只是战争间隙的代名词。总有一天我们会放弃这些权力。但在那之前，我们将以克制、目的和坚定的决心来运用它们。
entries.en: The galaxy has spoken, not in fear, but in trust. We have been chosen as Custodian and granted powers that reach beyond the bounds of ordinary mandate. These extraordinary privileges, though born of necessity, are not honors we sought. They are burdens we accept, for the sake of all.\n\nWe do not wield this authority to command, but to serve. Until peace is more than a pause between wars, until threats no longer lurk beyond the stars, we will uphold our oath. The time will come to relinquish these powers. But until then, we will wield them with restraint, purpose, and unwavering resolve.

entries.zh:
我们知道这一天终将到来。尽管我们努力团结和提升，但星系现在面临着一场生存的清算。这个敌人不讲仁慈，不讲妥协。它威胁着一切，因此我们必须为一切而战。

我们所建立的每一次联盟，所经历的每一次磨难，都将我们带到了这一刻。我们不凌驾于银河系之上；我们为它而战。对抗毁灭，对抗绝望，我们崛起。不是作为征服者，而是作为守护者。

今天，无论如何，我们都不能退缩。
entries.en:
We knew this day would come. For all our efforts to unify and uplift, the galaxy now faces an existential reckoning. This enemy knows no mercy, no compromise. It threatens all, and so we must stand for all.

Every alliance forged and hardship endured has brought us to this moment. We do not stand above the galaxy; we stand for it. Against annihilation, against despair, we rise. Not as conquerors, but as guardians.

Today, of all days, we must not falter.

entries.zh: 新一代的大使们如今正活跃在参议院的殿堂中。他们训练有素，耐心无限，对我们的事业无比忠诚。他们不仅以雄辩，更以真诚来发声，体现了我们对团结与和平的承诺。他们的工作也许不会登上头条，但他们却是缔造持久和平与合作的细致而精密的工匠。\n\n他们的每一句话，每一个姿态，都经过精心校准，旨在强化一个真理：我们不谋求霸权，只求稳定。我们没有什么可隐瞒的，因此，也无所畏惧。
entries.en: A new generation of ambassadors now walks the halls of the Senate. Carefully trained, endlessly patient, and utterly devoted to our cause, they speak not merely with eloquence, but with sincerity, embodying our commitment to unity and peace. Their work might not command headlines, but they are the minute and precise artisans of lasting peace and cooperation.\n\nEvery word, every gesture, calibrated to reinforce one truth: we seek no dominion, only stability. We have nothing to hide, and thus, nothing to fear.

entries.zh: 没有哪一场外交上的胜利是微不足道的。
entries.en: No diplomatic victory is too small.

entries.zh: 符号并非与生俱来，而是经过精心而审慎的打造。如果我们的英雄要成为希望的灯塔，他们的舰船就必须体现这一角色。它们不仅仅是作战舰船，更必须是引领我们穿越黑暗的灯塔。\n\n白色和金色的船体，闪闪发光的船首雕像，以及兼具优雅与威严的设计。在内部，搭载着我们技术所能提供的最先进设备，不惜一切代价。这些舰船承载的不仅是火力，更是信心。它们是这一愿景的先锋：面对湮灭，团结、强大、坚定不移。
entries.en: A symbol is not born, it is carefully and deliberately made. If our heroes are to stand as beacons of hope, their ships must reflect that role. No mere combat ships; they must be the beacon that guides us through the dark.\n\nWhite and gold hulls, gleaming figureheads, and a design both elegant and formidable. Under the hood, the best that our technology can offer, no expense spared. These ships carry not just firepower, but reassurance. They are the vanguard of a vision: unity, strength, and unwavering resolve in the face of oblivion.
They shall fan the flame of hope.

entries.zh: 我们的调查结出了严峻而无可辩驳的果实。从深空观测站、秘密监听站到古老的数据库，种种迹象都表明：有什么东西正在到来。\n\n这不是虚惊一场，也不是被误解的异常。威胁是真实的、迫在眉睫的，其规模之大，超出了常规防御的范畴。我们没有时间犹豫。我们所做的一切准备都必须现在完成。时间已晚，但我们并未毫无准备。让他们来吧。
entries.en: Our investigations have borne grim, irrefutable fruit. Across deep-space observatories, classified listening posts, and ancient data vaults, the signs align: something is coming.\n\nThis is no false alarm, no misinterpreted anomaly. The threat is real, imminent, and of a scale that defies routine defense. We have no time for hesitation. Every preparation we have made must now be completed. The hour is late, but we are not unready. Let them come.
Fear will learn to fear us.

entries.zh: 我们的警惕再次得到了证实。正当星系准备应对一种生存威胁时，我们又发现了另一种威胁的萌芽。它潜伏在视线之外，但证据确凿：危险是真实的，而且正在逼近。\n\n然而这一次，我们并非措手不及。我们将再次掌握主动权，在其积聚全部力量之前发动打击。前方的战斗将是残酷的，但有了出其不意的优势，我们并非毫无准备。让星辰作证：我们不会动摇。现在不会，永远也不会。
entries.en: Our vigilance has once again been vindicated. Even as the galaxy braces against one existential threat, we have uncovered the stirrings of another. It lurks just out of sight, but the evidence is unmistakable: the danger is real, and it is advancing.\n\nYet this time, we are not caught unaware. We will seize the initiative again, striking before it can gather its full strength. The battle ahead will be brutal, but with the element of surprise on our side, we do not face it unprepared. Let the stars bear witness: we will not falter. Not now, not ever.

entries.zh: 随着决议的通过，圣武士倡议不再是一个理论构想，而是一个获得官方批准的项目。这标志着各成员国将开始协调努力，制定实现该倡议所需的理论、人员和物资标准。\n\n虽然[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]的各个成员国将各自负责招募圣武士，但我们仍需监督开发一系列全新的顶级舰艇供他们使用。
entries.en: With the passage of the resolution, the Paladin Initiative is no longer a theoretical construct but an officially sanctioned project. This marks the beginning of a coordinated effort across member states to develop the doctrine, personnel, and material standards necessary for its realization.\n\nWhile members of the [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium] will be handling the recruitment of their Paladins, we must still oversee the development of a new series of top-of-the-line ships for them to use.

entries.zh: 圣武士之舰的研发工作已经完成。它们是优雅与力量的融合，是我们决心的象征。虽然为战争而武装，但它们的目的却是和平，它们承诺：无论何处需求最大，我们都将身处其中。
entries.en: The development of Paladin ships is complete. A fusion of elegance and strength, they stand as symbols of our resolve. Though armed for war, their purpose is peace, and they serve as a promise: that we will be there, wherever the need is greatest.

entries.zh: 我们已经完成了圣武士之舰的组装。它镀金的船体在星光下柔和地闪耀，引擎嗡嗡作响，充满力量。将这样一件艺术品送上战场，似乎近乎犯罪。\n\n现在，我们必须将它托付给一位配得上它的勇士，一位其决心与飞船的力量相媲美，其勇气将指引它驶向无论何种黑暗的核心的勇士。
entries.en: We have completed the assembly of a Paladin ship. Its gilded hull shines softly in starlight, and its engines hum with power. It seems almost criminal to send such a piece of art into battle.\n\nNow, we must entrust it to a champion worthy of its charge, one whose resolve mirrors the vessel's strength, and whose courage will guide it into the heart of whatever darkness awaits.

entries.zh: 唯有最高贵者方可踏上侍奉之路。
[Root.GetName]，我们最近提名的圣武士，在§Y[Root.GetPaladinSubclass]§!方面表现出了极大的才能。我们可以引导[Root.GetHimHer]转向另一个专业，但这需要付出巨大的努力，不仅要训练他们，还要重塑他们的公众形象以适应新的叙事。
entries.en: [Root.GetName], our recently nominated Paladin, has shown great aptitude as a §Y[Root.GetPaladinSubclass]§!. We could steer [Root.GetHimHer] towards another specialization, but it would take significant efforts to not only train them but also reshape their public image to fit the new narrative.

entries.zh: 鉴于对星系稳定的直接威胁已被遏制，且其使命已完成，圣武士计划已自然终结。根据其委任条款，该部队将解散。他们的舰艇将被退役，指挥结构将解体。\n\n圣武士们留下的只有在星系危急时刻站出来响应号召、奉献自我的记忆。他们的行动赢得了跨越界限的尊重，他们的解散并非失败的体现，而是成功的象征。和平最终不再需要英雄。
entries.en: With the immediate threats to galactic stability contained and its mandate fulfilled, the Paladin initiative has reached its natural conclusion. In accordance with the terms of their commission, the unit will stand down. Their vessels will be decommissioned, their command structures dissolved.\n\nThe Paladins leave behind only the memory of service rendered in the galaxy's hour of need. Their actions have earned respect across borders, and their disbandment is a reflection not of failure, but of success. Peace, at last, requires no champions.

entries.zh: 鉴于敌对行动不断升级以及对统一军事协调日益增长的需求，圣武士先锋队已被正式置于监管人的指挥之下。尽管他们最初的使命强调独立性和广泛合作，但当前形势要求建立更直接的指挥链。\n\n这一决定并非轻率之举。圣武士仍然是受人尊敬的人物，但他们现在将在我们战略部队的既定等级制度内服役。由于我们比以往任何时候都更需要他们，他们的行动将继续进行，但将作为一支协调部队而非自治特工。任务没有改变。
entries.en: In light of escalating hostilities and the increasing need for unified military coordination, the Paladin Vanguard has been formally placed under Custodian command. While their original mandate emphasized independence and broad cooperation, present circumstances demand a more direct chain of authority.\n\nThis decision was not taken lightly. The Paladins remain respected figures, but they now serve within the established hierarchy of our strategic forces. As we need them more than ever, their operations will continue but as a coordinated force rather than autonomous agents. The mission has not changed.

entries.zh: 随着眼前的危机解除，集中指挥不再被视为必要，圣武士先锋队的行动控制权已恢复其原有框架。监管人的直接监督已经结束，圣武士将再次在星系理事会成员的领导下行动。\n\n这种自主权的恢复重申了我们对透明度和多边信任的承诺。圣武士仍然是团结的象征，而非从属。他们不能为单一势力服务，而应为集体意志服务。
entries.en: With the immediate crisis abated and centralized command no longer deemed necessary, operational control of the Paladin Vanguard has been returned to its original framework. The Custodian's direct oversight has concluded, and the Paladins will once again act under the members of the Galactic Council.\n\nThis restoration of autonomy reaffirms our commitment to transparency and multilateral trust. The Paladins remain a symbol of unity, not subordination. They must serve no single power, but of the collective will.

entries.zh: 威胁已经过去。星系曾一度濒临崩溃，如今正处于谨慎复苏的时期。使命已尽，我们迈出了最后一步：已放弃守护者的权力。始于危机的应对，终于信任的行动。\n\n我们建立的联盟，我们树立的榜样。这些将是我们的遗产。选择不统治而领导，不占有而保护，我们秉持了我们的原则。星系目前是安全的，这就足够了。
entries.en: The threats have passed. The galaxy, once on the brink, now finds itself in a time of cautious renewal. With no mandate left to fulfill, we have taken the final step: the Custodian's powers have been surrendered. What began as a response to crisis has ended as an act of trust.\n\nThe alliances we built, the example we've set. These will be our legacy. In choosing to lead without ruling, to protect without possessing, we have upheld our principles. The stars are secure, for now, and that is enough.

entries.zh: 我们现在可以歇一歇了。
这位领袖身负圣武士的重任。他们通过言行举止，本身就体现了英勇，是自由星海的斗士。
entries.en: This leader bears the mantle of the Paladin. Through word and deed, they embody valor itself, champions of a free galaxy.

entries.zh: 这位领袖无需§Y维护费§!，也不占用§Y领袖上限§!
entries.en: This leader has no §YUpkeep§! and does not take up §YLeader Capacity§!

entries.zh: 这位圣武士擅长通过瞬间的决策和反应，以极高的精准度直击敌人心脏。
entries.en: With snap decisions and reflexes, this Paladin is expert at threading the needle to strike at the heart of our enemies.

entries.zh: 这位冷静沉着的圣武士善于制定计划，能最大限度地发挥同伴的优势。
entries.en: Calm and collected, this calculating Paladin is expert at formulating plans that will bring out the best in their companions.

entries.zh: 恒星系内舰队：$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—舰船武器射速：§G+30%§!
entries.en: Fleets in system:$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Ship Fire Rate: §G+30%§!

entries.zh: 这位专注的圣武士耐心而精准，擅长发出决定性的一击。
entries.en: Patient and precise, this focused Paladin is expert at delivering the decisive strike.

entries.zh: 这位圣武士敏捷的思维和科学训练让他们即使在激烈的战斗中也能解决后勤和维护问题。
entries.en: The quick mind and scientific training of this Paladin lets them solve logistic and maintenance questions, even in the heat of battle.

entries.zh: 恒星系内舰队：$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—舰船维护费：§G-15%§!
这位坚定不移的圣武士相信船和船员能够顶住压倒性的困难，并随时准备保护任何有需要的盟友。
entries.en: This stalwart and unflinching Paladin trusts in the ship and the crew to stand firm against overwhelming odds, and is always ready to shield any ally in need.

entries.zh: 这位勇敢的圣武士不惧怕在前线作战，协调盟友击败最可怕的敌人。
entries.en: This brave Paladin does not shy away from fighting in the front line, coordinating allies to strike down even the most fearsome foe.

entries.zh: 这位圣武士已立下勇气誓言。他们在战场上无与伦比的技艺，唯有其不可动摇的决心能与之匹敌。
entries.en: This Paladin has taken the oath of valor. Their peerless skill in battle is matched only by their unshakeable resolve.
£trigger_no£ We can only support a single §Y$paladin_ship$§!

entries.zh: 艺术与技术融合，创造出闪耀在黑暗中的自由象征。
entries.en: Art meets technology to create symbols of freedom that will shine bright against the darkness.

entries.zh: 这优雅的徽章表明这艘船由一名圣武士指挥，他是星海共同体的捍卫者。
entries.en: This elegant crest marks the ship as being commanded by a Paladin, champion of the Galactic Community.

entries.zh:
这艘舰船获得以下增益，持续§Y£time£3个月§!：
—§G+1000%§! $MOD_SHIP_SHIELD_MULT$
—§G+75%§! $MOD_SHIP_SHIELD_REGEN_ADD_PERC$
—§G+15%§! $MOD_SHIP_SHIELD_HARDENING_ADD$
\n该恒星系中的一支随机§R敌对舰队§!受到高达§Y3750§!点伤害。我们在§Y星海共同体§!中每拥有§Y100,000§!点£diplo_weight£外交权重，此效果就会重复生效一次。
entries.en: \nA random §RHostile Fleet§! in this System suffers up to §Y3750§! damage. This effect repeats for every §Y100 000§! £diplo_weight£ Diplomatic Weight that we carry in the §YGalactic Community§!.

entries.zh: \n将圣武士舰船传送至最近的非敌对恒星基地，并修复其最多§G25%§!的§Y装甲§!和§Y船体§!。
entries.en: \nTeleports the Paladin ship to the nearest non-hostile Starbase and repairs up to §G25%§! of its §YArmor§! and §YHull§!.

entries.zh:
§Y£time£3个月§!内，该恒星系内的所有圣武士舰船获得：
—§G+7.5%§!$MOD_SHIP_DAMAGE_REDUCTION_MULT$
—§G+7.5%§!$MOD_SHIP_FIRE_RATE_MULT$
—§G+7.5%§!$MOD_SHIP_EVASION_MULT$

该效果受恒星系内的圣武士数量倍乘。
entries.en:
For §Y£time£3 Months§!, every Paladin Ship in this System gains:
- §G+7.5%§! $MOD_SHIP_DAMAGE_REDUCTION_MULT$
- §G+7.5%§! $MOD_SHIP_FIRE_RATE_MULT$
- §G+7.5%§! $MOD_SHIP_EVASION_MULT$

This effect is multiplied by the amount of Paladins in the system.
£trigger_no£ This ship already under the effects of §H$paladin_teamwork$§!

entries.zh:
所有恒星系内的友方船只获得以下效果，持续§Y£time£3个月§!：

—§G+20%§! $MOD_SHIP_WEAPON_DAMAGE$
—§G+20%§! $MOD_SHIP_SPEED_MULT$

entries.zh: \n这一危险的试作型武器组合将产生不可预知的影响。
entries.en: \nThis dangerous assortment of prototype weapons will have unpredictable effects.
